svg.title: Faces of a plane K4 and a face boundary that traverses a bridge twice
svg.desc: The left panel is a crossing-free embedding of K4 with four faces. The right panel is a triangle with a bridge drawn into its interior face; that face has boundary length five because the bridge is traversed in both directions.
